commands.author: jesse-merhi

target.title: fix(signal): restore native replies for Signal sends
target.body:
## Summary

Signal native replies now stay inside the Signal plugin boundary. Direct Signal replies derive the quote author from the normalized Signal target, while group replies persist the inbound Signal sender by account, conversation, and message timestamp so later durable sends can attach Signal native quote metadata.

The shared outbound/channel/queue/durable `replyToAuthor` plumbing from earlier branch history is not in the current net diff. Raw Signal `replyToId` message-action inputs are now handled by Signal's own send-payload preparation hook, matching the provider-owned shape used by channels like Telegram instead of special-casing Signal in shared outbound normalization.

## What Changed

- Signal send paths: message adapter sends, formatted text/media, and attached-result text/media now pass `replyToId` into Signal send options and resolve the required Signal quote author locally.
- Signal message action: raw `replyToId` send arguments are converted into durable payload `replyToId` by `extensions/signal/src/message-actions.ts`; canonical `replyTo` still stays on the core path, and existing payload `replyToId` values are preserved.
- Direct Signal targets: phone/UUID direct targets keep their native author value, and username targets serialize quote authors as `u:<name>` for `signal-cli` while preserving OpenClaw's normalized `username:<name>` send target.
- Signal group targets: inbound messages register sender authors under their message timestamp, including edited messages under `editMessage.targetSentTimestamp` and mention-skipped group messages that still enter pending history.
- Signal reply-author storage: a new bounded in-memory cache uses the optional plugin state store when available, but persistent store open/lookup/register failures remain best-effort and do not abort message handling.

## Proof

Behavioral proof in the net diff:

- Direct Signal native replies to `signal:+15551234567` and `signal:u:Alice` attach quote metadata with `+15551234567` and `u:alice` quote authors.
- Group Signal native replies resolve quote authors from Signal-owned author persistence instead of a shared outbound context field.
- Raw Signal `replyToId` action inputs are prepared in the Signal plugin payload hook; shared outbound normalization has no net Signal-specific change.
- Edited Signal messages register the original target timestamp so replies to edited messages can still quote the author.
- Mention-skipped group messages keep pending-history context and now register the reply author for later mentioned replies to those ids.
- Persistent reply-author state failures fall back to memory rather than failing inbound handling or reply sends.

Screenshots: not included because this is backend/channel delivery behavior with no human-visible UI surface changed.

## Verification

Reviewer-checkable behavior on head `0b1c8c605ab30f1e0dfaea8d9fcf9b5a30e477d7`:

- PR proof-pack net diff reported base `origin/main 7e0324263b86`, head `0b1c8c605ab3`, 8 net changed files, all under `extensions/signal/src/**`; `src/infra/outbound/message-action-normalization.ts` and its test are now branch-only churn with no net diff.
- `git diff --check` passed locally.
- Blacksmith Testbox via Crabbox `tbx_01kx2cvyn4ssr3f5r01fkh9p04` (`coral-lobster`) passed `env CI=true corepack pnpm test extensions/signal/src/message-actions.test.ts extensions/signal/src/core.test.ts src/infra/outbound/message-action-normalization.test.ts`.
- Blacksmith Testbox via Crabbox `tbx_01kx2cvyn4ssr3f5r01fkh9p04` (`coral-lobster`) passed `env CI=true OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 corepack pnpm check:changed -- extensions/signal/src/message-actions.test.ts extensions/signal/src/message-actions.ts src/infra/outbound/message-action-normalization.test.ts src/infra/outbound/message-action-normalization.ts`.

Known proof gap:

- Live Signal daemon/container round-trip was not run in this environment; the proof is code-path review plus focused Signal/core tests.
- `$code-review` and `$clawsweeper` were clean/no-defect on previous head `31f68d06afa8153f763b7034e4f30a40acefea18`, but must be rerun for current head `0b1c8c605ab30f1e0dfaea8d9fcf9b5a30e477d7` before this PR is considered fully closed out.

Review note: this refresh intentionally keeps the fix Signal-scoped and avoids broader shared channel changes.
